stance: Growth: nominal consumer spending is strong, with retail sales up 0.77% m/m and 6.29% y/y in September after +1.29% in August. Part of the beat is gasoline (ex-gas +0.2%, unconfirmed beyond one news source), so underlying demand is solid but below the headline. Business investment is positive: core capex orders +0.46% in September after +1.55%, a slower gain. Watch the control group, real spending and core capex for GDP. A fall in gas prices would reverse the retail boost.
